fix.explicit_sid: CryptUpdateProtectedState receives the actual service token SID, rather than NULL. On this host only the explicit SID restored actual canary decryption. Migration counters alone never grant readiness.
fix.identity: Actual OperiaSvc SCM process, medium integrity, no administrator/SYSTEM membership. User-scope DPAPI retained; no machine-scope fallback.
fix.credential_transaction: Known old/new change, 52-character CSPRNG credentials, sealed previous/pending until same ciphertext canary decrypts and readiness succeeds. Recovery reports whether pending committed or previous credential was restored.
fix.failure_rollback: A separately published integrity-checked candidate forces migration failure. The verified prior credential and identical DPAPI canary are recovered before clearing pending/previous. No database rollback.
fix.local_channel: One-instance local admin-owned named pipe verifies client service SID; no plaintext secret files, argv or environment.
fix.scm_probe: Synthetic crash uses isolated failure reset=0; finally restores 86400 seconds and the bounded restart sequence. Admin handle requests only CHANGE_CONFIG|START, as required for restart actions.

legacy_limit: V1 is a fixed synthetic canary from an earlier failed prototype. Ciphertext remains unchanged; original credential is unavailable and decryption is not recovered. It contains no evidence, reports, signing keys or passwords.
